assumptions: All 64 GND physical pads become connected, so the stage records 64 full 64-pad RPC responses.
Current saved/native source lengths are used for every source copy; added zone/fill bytes are omitted.
PAD item sizes are measured from the transferred real native receipt by SMD/PTH type, not measured from the current post-fill board.
RPC/header, complete PAD/footprint inventories, padstack presence, zone protos and JSON string escaping are omitted.
conclusion: This is a capacity estimate, not an observed native failure. The repeated source/PAD representation approaches or exceeds the unchanged 8 MiB artifact cap before other required data. Do not claim that a fill was attempted or succeeded. Preserve all evidence and use lossless compact storage rather than truncating observations.
